x-k-k1-01.title: Calaamaddee ayaa u hagta baarkinka?
x-k-k1-01.goal: Akhri saddex calaamad waddo oo gaaban, isku dar erayada fallaadhaha iyo calaamadda la sharaxay, oo go'aami kee runtii u hagta marti inay baarkiso; kala dood xukunka akhrin badh ah ee saaxiib.
x-k-k1-01.material:
Marti ayaa gaari ku imanaya dugsi oo rabta inay gaarigeeda ka tago hal saac. Saddex calaamad ayaa muuqda (sawirro ma jiraan, sidaas darteed waxaa lagu sharaxay erayo).

Calaamadda A: xarfo cadcad '주차 금지' looh cas. Goobo cas oo xariiq dhinaca u jaarka ayaa gooyaa sawir yar oo gaari ah. Waxaa lagu xiray deyrka dugsiga.
Calaamadda B: looh buluug ah, xarfo cadcad '방문자 주차장' iyo fallaadho ku jeedda midigta. Waxay taagan tahay dhinaca waddada.
Calaamadda C: looh cagaar ah, xarfo cadcad '주차장 출구' iyo fallaadho ku jeedda dib xagga waddada. Waxay ka laalaadsan tahay waddo cidhiidhi ah oo gaadiidku ka baxayaan.

Erayada: 주차(장) = baarkin (goob baarkin); 방문자 = marti; 입구 = albaab gal; 출구 = albaab bax.
x-k-k1-01.thinking.0: Isku-darka eray, calaamad iyo fallaadho sida caddayn
x-k-k1-01.thinking.1: Ha ku joogsan hal eray la yaqaan (주차장)
x-k-k1-01.thinking.2: Ka jawaabidda saaxiib iyadoo la isticmaalayo caddaymaha calaamadda
x-k-k1-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa shaqalada Hangul si qaylo ah
x-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan in fallaadho calaamad ku jirta ay muujiso jidka la raaco
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Calaamaddee ayaa martidu raacdaa si ay u baarkiso?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Liis garee waxa calaamad kastaa ku leedahay erayo, iyo waxa calaamaddeeda ama fallaadhideeda ay ku darto.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Calaamad kasta weydii: ma u dirtaa gaari gudaha, dibadda, mise meel dhex ah?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.a: 주차장 waxay ku jirtaa calaamaddan, laakiin waa hal eray oo ka mid ah labo. Hubi waxa eraygii labaad iyo fallaadhadu ka sheegayaan jihada ay gaadiidku qaadaan.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Calaamaddan sidoo kale waxay leedahay 주차. Eeg goobta cas ee xariiqda leh: maxay calaamaddaas noocaas ahi badanaa kuu sheegtaa?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad isku dartay erayga martida, erayga baarkinka iyo fallaadhada. Taasi waa sida calaamad loo akhriyo oo dhan.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.o.d: Calaamadda B ama calaamadda C; labadaba waxay leeyihiin 주차장 iyo fallaadho
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.d: Labadaba waxay leeyihiin 주차장 iyo fallaadho, laakiin hubi waxa eraygii kale ee calaamadda C iyo jihada fallaadhideeda ay sheegayaan.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: Calaamadda B waa marti, waxay magacaabtaa goob baarkin waxayna bixisaa jihada. Calaamadda A waxay leedahay isla eraygii hore laakiin waxay sidataa calaamad mamnuucid. Calaamadda C sidoo kale waxay magacaabtaa goob baarkin, laakiin 출구 macnaheedu waa albaab bax, sidaas darteed waxay calaamadaysaa halka gaadiidku ka baxaan.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa yidhi: 'Sign C has 주차장 in it, so let's drive in through there.' Ka jawaab saaxiibkaa hal ama laba weedhood Ingiriis ah, adigoo isticmaalaya waxa calaamaddu runtii leedahay.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Eraygee ee calaamadda C ayaa ka duwan kan calaamadda B?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Xaggee ayay gaadiidku aadaan waddo leh calaamad albaab bax?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaalay erayga calaamadda sida caddayn, ma aha oo keliya ra'yigayga?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay waxa calaamaddu u tahay (ka bixitaanka) iyo waxa aan halkii u baahanahay?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma saaxiibkay ayaa ogaan lahaa meesha xigta ee uu eego?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Sign C says 출구, which means exit. Cars drive out there, so we should look for an entrance, like the arrow on Sign B.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.modelNote.0: Waxay magacaabtaa erayga muhiimka ah iyo albaabka gelitaanka ee maqan.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: 주차장 waa badhkii oo keliya. Eraygii kale, 출구, wuxuu noo sheegayaa in gaadiidku halkaas ka baxayaan, sidaas darteed waxaan wadi lahayn jihada khaldan.

x-k-k1-07.title: Goorma ayaad gali kartaa maktabadda?
x-k-k1-07.goal: Akhri calaamad leh dhawr sadar, go'aami sadarrada muhiimka ah maalin la bixiyey, kadibna hel dhawr waqti oo imaatin oo ku habboon dhammaantood.
x-k-k1-07.material:
Calaamad albaabka maktabadda ku taal (hal sadar saf kasta):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Erayada: 오전 = a.m.; 오후 = p.m.; 낮 = duhurka; 쉬어요 = (way) nasataa; ~ waxaa loo akhriyaa 'ilaa' (laga bilaabo ... ilaa ...). Waxaad rabtaa inaad booqato Arbacada.
x-k-k1-07.thinking.1: Helitaanka dhawr xal oo laba xad ah hoostooda
x-k-k1-07.thinking.2: Sharaxaadda sababta waqtiyada kale ay u fashilmaan
x-k-k1-07.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhrin karaa Hangul iyo tirooyinka leh 시
x-k-k1-07.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan in 오전 yahay subax 오후-na yahay galab
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.prompt: Sadarrada calaamadda ee muhiimka u ah booqasho Arbaco? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta weydii: ma quseeyaa Arbacada?
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hal sadar waa magac; mid kale wuxuu ku saabsan yahay maalin kale.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.a: Tani waa magaca meesha; ma xadido waqtigaaga.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in sadarkan uu bixiyo saacadaha maalin caadi ah.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad aragtay in meeshu ay joogsato wax yar maalinta gudaheeda.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.d: Sadarkan wuxuu ku saabsan yahay Axadda; maalintaadu waa Arbaco.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 2 iyo 3 way quseeyaan maalin kasta oo caadi ah. Sadarka 1 waa magac sadarka 4-na wuxuu ku saabsan yahay Axadda oo keliya.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.prompt: Hel saddex waqti oo kala duwan Arbacada oo aad imaan karto oo maktabaddu furan tahay. Waqti kasta waa 'h:30'; geli saacadda h saacad 24-saac ah (1 p.m. = 13).
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor saacadaha furitaanka iyo xidhitaanka sida tirooyin 24-saac ah.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka saar saacadda nasashada, kadibna tijaabi tirooyinkaaga.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.var.h: saacadda h ee waqtiga imaatinka h:30 (0-23)
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Inta u dhexeysa furitaanka iyo xidhitaanka.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Maktabaddu waa furan tahay laga bilaabo 9:00 ilaa 18:00, sidaas darteed h:30 waa inuu ku jiraa xaddigaas.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.explain: Waqtiyada furan waa 9:30 ilaa 11:30 iyo 13:30 ilaa 17:30 sida imaatin h:30. 12:30 wuxuu ku jiraa nasashada, 8:30 iyo 18:30-na waxay ka baxsan yihiin saacadaha furitaanka.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Qor hal ama laba weedhood oo Ingiriis ah oo loo diro saaxiib leh 'it is open from 9 to 6, any time is fine': waqtiyadee ayaa fashilma, maxaase u sabab ah?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sadarkee ee calaamadda ayuu saaxiibkaa ka booday?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ma saaxiibkaygu hadda qorsheyn karaa booqasho?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Inta u dhexeysa 12 iyo 1 way nasataa (쉬어요), 9 ka hor ama 6 kadib-na waa xidhan tahay.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ha imaan waqtiga qadada, 12 ilaa 1. Maktabaddu waxay leedahay nasasho markaas, sidaas darteed dooro waqti kale inta u dhexeysa 9 iyo 6.

x-k-k1-02.title: Haddii ay da'do roob, miyuu bandhigu socdaa?
x-k-k1-02.topic: Waxa calaamad ku leedahay iyo waxa aysan ku lahayn
x-k-k1-02.goal: Is barbardhig qoraal Ingiriis ah oo la qaaday iyo ogeysiiska Kuuriyaanka asalka ah, hel xariiqda sheegaysa wax ka badan ogeysiiska, oo qor xeerka Kuuriyaanka adigu.
x-k-k1-02.material:
Macallin ayaa ogeysiis ku dhejiyay albaabka fasalka:

내일은 소풍 가요.
9시까지 학교에 오세요.
도시락을 가져오세요.
비가 오면 소풍을 안 가요.

Erayada: 소풍 = safar/bandhig; 도시락 = sanduuqa qadada; 비 = roob; 오다 = imaan (비가 오다 = roob ayaa da'ay); 안 = ma.

Joon ayaa akhriyay oo qoray afar qoraal Ingiriis ah (hoose lagu muujiyay).

Erayo dheeraad ah (tallaabada 2): 눈 = baraf (눈이 오다 = baraf ayaa da'ay); 공원 = beer.
x-k-k1-02.thinking.0: Hubinta soo koobid xariiq xariiq iyadoo la barbardhigayo isha
x-k-k1-02.thinking.2: Dib u qorista shuruudda Kuuriyaan ahaan
x-k-k1-02.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa Hangul iyo weedho edeb leh oo gaaban
x-k-k1-02.prereq.1: Wuu la kulmay dhammaadka -(으)면 iyo fikradda 'if' weedho fudud
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.prompt: Mid ka mid ah qoraallada Joon wuxuu sheegayaa wax ka badan waxa ogeysiisku sheegayo. Xariiqdee?
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Is barbardhig qoraal kasta iyo ogeysiiska, hal xariiq mar.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qoraalkee ayaa sheegaya wax hubaal ah oo ogeysiisku sheego oo keliya sida shuruud?
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.line.1: Waa inaan dugsiga joognaa 9 ugu dambayn.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.line.3: Berri roob ayaa da'i doona, sidaa darteed soo-socod ma jiro.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 4 waa dhibaatada. Ogeysiisku wuxuu sheegayaa waxa dhaca haddii roob da'o (비가 오면); ma sheego inuu roob da'i doono. Joon wuxuu shuruud u beddelay saadaal.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.prompt: Ogeysiis kale, oo lagu yidhi Ingiriisi: "If it snows tomorrow, we do not go to the park." Qor xeerkan Kuuriyaan (edeb -요), adigoo isticmaalaya erayada kor ku xusan.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Labada qaybood ee kee ayaa ay tahay inay weedha ku jiraan: shuruudda iyo waxa dhaca?
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi in weedhaadu aysan sheegin in baraf DA'I DOONO.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma weedhaydu waxay ka kooban tahay 'haddii baraf da'o' ma aha 'baraf wuu da'ay'?
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Qaab hadal ah oo isku macno ah.

x-k-k1-10.topic: Waxa calaamad ku leedahay iyo waxa aysan ku lahayn
x-k-k1-10.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa weedho gaagaaban oo Hangul ah
x-k-k1-10.title: Tufaaxa waa iibsaday. Maxaa ku saabsan pears?
x-k-k1-10.goal: Kala saar waxa calaamad gaaban sheegto iyo waxa aad qiyaaso, oo dooro su'aalaha xallin lahaa waxa calaamaddu furan ka tagto.
x-k-k1-10.material:
Albaabka dukaan midho (nalalku waa shidan yihiin, naag ayaa gudaha ku habaynaysa sanduuqyo) waxaa ku yaal calaamad:

사과 다 팔았어요. 내일 오세요.

Erayada: 사과 = tufaax; 배 = pear; 다 = dhammaan; 팔았어요 = la iibiyey; 내일 오세요 = fadlan berri kaalay.

Saaxiibkaa ayaa akhriyey calaamadda oo sameeyey afar qoraal (hoose). Waxaad rabtaa inaad iibsato pears.
x-k-k1-10.thinking.0: Hubinta sheegasho kasta iyadoo la eegayo calaamadda
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.prompt: Mid ka mid ah qoraallada saaxiibkaa wuu dhaafayaa waxa calaamaddu leedahay. Kee?
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Qoraal kasta tilmaan erayga calaamadda ee taageera.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Qoraalkee ayaa ka hadlaya wax calaamaddu waligeed ku sheegin?
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.0: Calaamaddu waxay leedahay tufaaxa waa la iibiyey.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.1: Sidaas darteed dukaanku hadda tufaax ma haysto.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.2: Sidaas darteed dukaanku pears sidoo kale ma haysto.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.line.3: Calaamaddu waxay na weydiisaa inaan berri soo noqonno.
x-k-k1-10.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 ayaa ah. Calaamaddu waxay leedahay 사과 (tufaax); ma sheego waxba oo ku saabsan pears (배). Sadarrada kale calaamadda ayay ku jiraan.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad gudaha u gashaa inaad weydiiso naagta. Su'aalaha Kuuriyaanka ah ee kee ayaa xallin lahaa inaad pears iibsan karto maanta? Dooro dhammaan.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Su'aashee ayaa ku saabsan pears iyo maanta?
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Su'aashee ayaa ku saabsan tufaax ama maalin kale?
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.a: Si toos ah ayaad ugu weydiisay pears.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.b: Tufaaxa waa la iibiyey, sidaas darteed qiimahooda kuma caawinayo pears.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.c: Calaamadda waxaad u beddeshay su'aal ku saabsan pears.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.r.d: Tani waxay ku saabsan tahay berri, ma aha iibsiga pears maanta.
x-k-k1-10.s.s2.explain: Labada 배는 있어요? iyo 배도 다 팔았어요? waxay weydiiyaan pears hadda. Su'aalaha ku saabsan qiimaha tufaaxa ama waqtiga furitaanka berri ma xalliyaan.

x-k-k1-05.title: Isla war saaxiib iyo macallin
x-k-k1-05.goal: Dib u qor qoraal caadi ah si uu ugu habboonaado macallin, oo dheh qaybaha qoraalka ee ay ahayd in la beddelo.
x-k-k1-05.material:
Waxaad saaxiibkaa u dirtay qoraalkan:

나 내일 학교에 못 가. 아파.

Hadda waa inaad macallinkaaga (선생님) isla waxaas u sheegtaa fariin.

Erayada: 내일 = berri; 학교 = dugsi; 못 가 = ma tegi karo; 아파 = (waan) buka.

x-k-k1-05.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan dhammaadka edebta -요 iyo erayga 선생님

x-k-k1-05.s.s1.prompt: Qaybaha qoraalka saaxiibka ee kee ayaa ay tahay in la beddelo marka loo qoro 선생님? Dooro dhammaan kuwa khuseeya.

x-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.b: Maalintu waa isku mid dhegeyste kasta; xaqiiqooyinku ma beddelmaan.
x-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ogaatay in xitaa 'aniga' uu leeyahay qaab loo adeegsado macallin.
x-k-k1-05.s.s1.explain: Xaqiiqooyinku (berri, ma tegi karo dugsiga, buka) way sii jiraan. Dhammaadyadu waxay noqdaan edeb (-요 ama -ㅂ니다), 나 na wuxuu noqdaa 저 marka macallinka laga hadlayo.
x-k-k1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Dhammaadyadu waa isbeddelka ugu muhiimsan; beddelidda 나 oo 저 ah waa mid labaad oo ka sii yar.

x-k-k1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma weedh kastaa waxay u dhawaaqdaa edeb macallin?
x-k-k1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma macallinka ku salaantay ama ka raalli galay?

x-k-k1-08.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa weedho gaagaaban oo Hangul ah
x-k-k1-08.title: Xagee ka tirsan yahay 'shoes off'?
x-k-k1-08.goal: U kala saar hal calaamad meesha ay inta badan ka laadan tahay, adigoo isticmaalaya faahfaahinta muuqaal kasta, oo ogow waxa calaamaddu ka tagto oo aan la sheegin.
x-k-k1-08.material:
Calaamad ayaa leh: 신발을 벗고 들어오세요.

Erayada: 신발 = kabo; 벗다 = inaad dhaqaajiso; 들어오세요 = fadlan soo gal.

Saddex meelood, oo erayo lagu sharaxay:
Meesha 1: dukaan kabo. Macaamiishu waxay tijaabiyaan kabo oo ku socdaan roogga khafiifka ah.
Meesha 2: makhaayad yar. Meesha cuntadu waa dabaq alwaax kor loo qaaday oo leh miisas gaagaaban. Albaabka agtiisa safka kabaha ayaa taagan jaranjarada dhagaxa ah.
Meesha 3: jimicsiga dugsiga. Dabaqa alwaaxda shalay ayaa la dhalaaliyey. Ardaydu halkaas waxay xidhaan kabo gudaha ah oo nadiif ah.
x-k-k1-08.thinking.0: Isticmaalka faahfaahinta muuqaalka sida cadayn is-waafajin
x-k-k1-08.thinking.1: Is barbar dhigidda midka ugu habboon
x-k-k1-08.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan in calaamadaha ay la hadlaan dadka soo galaya
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Meel kasta weydii: dadka halkaas ma ku socdaan dabaqa kabaha?
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbar dhig faahfaahinta dabaqa iyo waxa dadku cagaha ku xidhan yihiin meel kasta.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad dareentay in macaamiishu u baahan yihiin kabaha oo xidhan ama ka baxsan si ay u tijaabiyaan lammaanayaal; is barbar dhig tilmaanta 'thin carpet'.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad isticmaashay dabaqa kor loo qaaday iyo kabaha jaranjarada ku yaal sida tilmaamo.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.c: Dabaqa la dhalaaliyey waa sabab lagu ilaaliyo, laakiin ardaydu halkaas horey ayay u xidhan yihiin kabo gudaha ah oo nadiif ah, sidaas darteed calaamad 'shoes off' si yar ayaa loo baahan yahay.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.explain: Makhaayaddu waxay leedahay tilmaamaha ugu cad (dabaq kor loo qaaday, kabaha jaranjarada). Jimicsigu waa ku habboonaan daciif sababtoo ah ardaydu horey ayay u xidhan yihiin kabo gudaha ah oo nadiif ah, dukaanka kabahuna waa kan ugu yar ee suurtagal ah sababtoo ah macaamiishu way tijaabiyaan kabo.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.prompt: Calaamaddu waxay leedahay oo keliya: 신발을 벗고 들어오세요. Kuwee ka mid ah su'aalahan ayaa calaamaddu JAWAABIN? Dooro dhammaan.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Mar kale akhri calaamadda oo calaamadee waxa ay kuu sheegayso inaad sameyso.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kadibna su'aal kasta ka hubi tilmaamahaas.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad aragtay in calaamaddu tidhaahdo ka saar, laakiin ma sheego meesha laga dhaafo.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.b: 들어오세요 ayaa tan ka jawaaba; calaamaddu waxay kuu sheegaysaa inaad soo gasho.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad dareentay in calaamaddu waxba ka sheegin sharaabaad.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.d: 벗고 ayaa si toos ah u jawaaba su'aashan.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.explain: Calaamaddu waxay jawaabtaa 'ka saar kabaha' (벗고) iyo 'soo gal' (들어오세요). Ma sheego meesha kabaha la dhigo ama in sharaabaad loo baahan yahay.
